p: Glenrothes is one of Scotland's post-war new towns, built from 1948, and the Kingdom Centre is its main shopping hub, with Lyon Square right at the heart of it.

Riverside Park is the town's big green space, with plenty of paths and play areas, and Balbirnie Park near Markinch is lovely for a wander through the woods. The Rothes Halls arts venue is also part of the town centre, handy if you're catching a show. Admiral is an 18+ adult gaming centre, so it's one for grown-ups only. Glenrothes also makes a decent base for exploring Fife, with St Andrews and the coast within an easy drive.
